considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows are insufficient for reliable identification of its four coupled parameters; the verified mechanism note calls for at least eight.
The target horizon is not long relative to the characteristic timescale, and the trajectory batch directly resolves the parameter-identification gap.
The observed history gap and coupled transient lag favor the stated memory mechanism over present-snapshot models.
